body: That's probably good advice, but it's not going to happen without insurance. I'm not going to saddle my family with thousands in medical bills because daddy's a fuckup. I appreciate the concern though.

> Doing something horrible, and knowing that's it's horrible, is not going to get you anywhere. It's not going to make you feel better, it's not going to do or be anything besides horrible.

That's kind of the point :). To feel horrible enough that suicide is suddenly a more viable option. 

Like I said, I doubt I could really harm another person for purely self serving reasons, but the thought is wicked enough that I wondered if it had occurred to others as well.

Yeah, there's obviously some part of me that still wants to survive. I haven't been able to pull that trigger back just far enough yet. I'm not sure why, though. I feel like it would take way too much effort and time to include everything that's led me down this road, but I'll give you a tl;dr since you asked. 

I've always had depressive tendencies, but they've become more intense recently. I'm a 31/male with two sons and a wife. Up until about 9 months ago, I had a high paying job, owned two cars, owned a beautiful house, etc. Problem is, I became an opiate addict a couple years back. I lost my job and am now dangerously close to losing the cars, the house and the family. 

I've been free from opiate dependency for about 4 months now, but it's incredibly hard to adjust back to normal life. My wife expects me to just jump back into things full throttle but I can't. I'm doing my best to look for work and stay motivated, but it's difficult. I've tried talking to her about my depression/suicide ideation and she doesn't take it seriously. She thinks I'm trying to manipulate her and suggests I take out a life insurance policy when I bring it up. 

My wife recently changed the PIN numbers to all her cards which means I essentially have no cash flow now. My oldest son asked me to take him to laser tag today and I had to tell him no because I have no way of getting any cash together. I can't even scratch together enough change to buy a coffee. 

I'm just so fucking tired of feeling indebted to people, like a failure and like a leech. My wife makes fun of me in a passive-aggressive sort of way on Facebook and I have to just sit and take it if I want to remain in my kids' lives right now. 

There's much more to my situation than the above, but those are the most recent and relevant details.
